title: Aakhri Chitthi - Coming Home
audience_promise: A gentle family mystery: Meera comes home to her mother's warmth, and the last letter her father left for that very day has vanished from Kamla's tin box.

hook.text: Before he passed, your father wrote a letter. He said, open it only when Meera is home.

rationale: The cut opens on Kamla's affectionate welcome (homecoming, mother-daughter bond). It then sets up the father's letter as hopeful suspense and lands the 'It's gone' beat. It closes on the rotis teasing so the family leaves warm and smiling. It uses only SC02 and SC03, which carry no review flags. It deliberately skips Arjun's cold 'guest' lines, the SC05 rooftop confrontation, and anything protected or unavailable, which respects the avoid list (confrontation, insults, threatening framing, resolution spoilers). Clips follow story order, total 44 seconds against a 45 second target, and are paced to let each beat breathe.
